metric: cpCER is a fraction, lower is better; an empty hypothesis has cpCER 1.0.

reproducibility_boundary: The released numeric tables support independent aggregation and consistency checks, and the method code supports reproduction on locally authorized inputs. End-to-end rerunning of the private S-FULLTAC arm remains unavailable; public Sortformer and Whisper weights must be obtained separately. This release does not independently validate the original audio or listening judgments.
